newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Indupa started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Indupa started as hold.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Comafi said Monday it started coverage of local petrochemical firm Indupa, controlled by Belgium's Solvay, with a hold recommendation.
-- Analysts Eduardo Cogorno and Esteban Marx mentioned in a report the following positive features of the company:

-- It is Argentina's main producer of PVC and caustic soda, it has an excellent management by Solvay, there is an unsatisfied local demand for its products, and it has signed promising contracts to buy energy and to be provided with ethylene for 15 years.

-- On the negative side, they mentioned an expected low profitability for the next two years and an expected stronger competition, mainly from Brazilian group Odebrecht, now the world's fifth PVC producer.
